failures.question: I want to analyze how the Signal-to-Noise Quality Indicator (SNQI) varies across different weather conditions. For each weather condition, give weather condition name, the average SNQI, the median SNQI, and count how many analyzable signals there are. Sort the result by average SNQI in descending order.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH signal_snqi AS (
  SELECT 
    s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm) AS SNQI,
    t.ObservStation
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.TelescRef = t.Telescregistry
  WHERE s.SnrRatio IS NOT NULL AND s.NoiseFloorDbm IS NOT NULL
),
weather_signals AS (
  SELECT 
    o.WeathProfile,
    ss.SNQI
  FROM signal_snqi ss
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON ss.ObservStation = o.ObservStation
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.WeathProfile,
    ws.SNQI,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.WeathProfile ORDER BY ws.SNQI) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ws.WeathProfile) AS cnt
  FROM weather_signals ws
)
SELECT 
  ws.WeathProfile,
  AVG(ws.SNQI) AS avg_snqi,
  (SELECT AVG(r2.SNQI) 
   FROM ranked r2 
   WHERE r2.WeathProfile = ws.WeathProfile 
     AND r2.rn IN ((r2.cnt+1)/2, (r2.cnt+2)/2)) AS median_snqi,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.SNQI > 0) AS analyzable_count
FROM weather_signals ws
GROUP BY ws.WeathProfile
ORDER BY avg_snqi DESC;
failures.sol_sql: WITH signal_quality AS ( SELECT s.SignalRegistry, s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm) AS SNQI, o.WeathProfile FROM Signals s JOIN Telescopes t ON s.TelescRef = t.TelescRegistry JOIN Observatories o ON t.ObservStation = o.ObservStation ), ranked_quality AS ( SELECT WeathProfile, SNQI, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY WeathProfile ORDER BY SNQI) as row_num, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY WeathProfile) as total_count FROM signal_quality ) SELECT WeathProfile, AVG(SNQI) AS avg_snqi, (SELECT SNQI FROM ranked_quality WHERE WeathProfile = rq.WeathProfile AND row_num = (total_count + 1) / 2) AS median_snqi, SUM(CASE WHEN SNQI > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS analyzable_signals FROM ranked_quality rq GROUP BY WeathProfile ORDER BY avg_snqi DESC;

failures.question: I want to find signals that might contain structured information by analyzing their stability patterns. For each candidate, show the signal ID, signal type, Signal Stability Metric, one field that contains a combined stability textual report formatted exactly as: "Frequency: <frequency stability>, Phase: <phase stability>, Integrity: <signal integrity>" and the CIP Classification Label.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH ss_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.SignalRegistry,
    s.SignalClass,
    (1.0 - ABS(s.FreqDriftHzs) / (s.FreqMhz * 1000.0)) * 
      (s.SigDurSec / NULLIF(1.0 + s.DoppShiftHz / 1000.0, 0)) AS SSM,
    sc.EntropyVal,
    s.ModIndex,
    sd.FreqStab,
    sd.PhaseStab,
    sd.SigIntegrity
  FROM signals s
  JOIN signalclassification sc ON s.SignalRegistry = sc.SignalRef
  JOIN signaldynamics sd ON s.SignalRegistry = sd.SignalRef
  WHERE s.FreqMhz IS NOT NULL AND s.FreqMhz != 0
    AND s.FreqDriftHzs IS NOT NULL
    AND s.SigDurSec IS NOT NULL
    AND s.DoppShiftHz IS NOT NULL
    AND (1.0 + s.DoppShiftHz / 1000.0) != 0
    AND sc.EntropyVal IS NOT NULL
    AND s.ModIndex IS NOT NULL
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT 
    SignalRegistry,
    SignalClass,
    SSM,
    'Frequency: ' || FreqStab || ', Phase: ' || PhaseStab || ', Integrity: ' || SigIntegrity AS stability_report,
    CASE
      WHEN SSM > 0.8 AND EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.8 AND ModIndex > 0.5 
        THEN 'Coherent Information Pattern Detected'
      WHEN SSM > 0.6 AND EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.9 
        THEN 'Potential Information Pattern'
      ELSE 'No Clear Pattern'
    END AS cip_label
  FROM ss_data
)
SELECT 
  SignalRegistry AS signal_id,
  SignalClass AS signal_type,
  SSM AS signal_stability_metric,
  stability_report,
  cip_label
FROM labeled
WHERE cip_label != 'No Clear Pattern'
ORDER BY signal_id;
failures.sol_sql: WITH stability_analysis AS ( SELECT s.SignalRegistry, s.SignalClass, s.FreqDriftHzs, s.FreqMhz, s.SigDurSec, s.DoppShiftHz, s.ModType, s.ModIndex, sd.SigIntegrity, sd.FreqStab, sd.PhaseStab, sc.EntropyVal, ((1 - ABS(s.FreqDriftHzs)/(s.FreqMhz * 1000)) * (s.SigDurSec/(1 + s.DoppShiftHz/1000))) AS SSM FROM Signals s INNER JOIN SignalDynamics sd ON s.SignalRegistry = sd.SignalRef INNER JOIN SignalClassification sc ON s.SignalRegistry = sc.SignalRef ), stability_attrs AS ( SELECT SignalRegistry, 'FreqStab' AS attribute, FreqStab AS value FROM stability_analysis UNION ALL SELECT SignalRegistry, 'PhaseStab' AS attribute, PhaseStab AS value FROM stability_analysis UNION ALL SELECT SignalRegistry, 'SigIntegrity' AS attribute, SigIntegrity AS value FROM stability_analysis ) SELECT sa.SignalRegistry, sa.SignalClass, ROUND(sa.SSM, 3) AS SSM, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN sa.attribute = 'FreqStab' THEN 'Frequency: ' || sa.value WHEN sa.attribute = 'PhaseStab' THEN 'Phase: ' || sa.value WHEN sa.attribute = 'SigIntegrity' THEN 'Integrity: ' || sa.value END, ', ') AS stability_factors, CASE WHEN sa.SSM > 0.8 AND sa.EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.8 AND sa.ModIndex > 0.5 THEN 'Coherent Information Pattern Detected' WHEN sa.SSM > 0.6 AND sa.EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.9 THEN 'Potential Information Pattern' ELSE 'No Clear Pattern' END AS pattern_assessment FROM ( SELECT sa.SignalRegistry, sa.SignalClass, sa.SSM, sa.EntropyVal, sa.ModType, sa.ModIndex, stability_attrs.attribute, stability_attrs.value FROM stability_analysis sa JOIN stability_attrs ON sa.SignalRegistry = stability_attrs.SignalRegistry ) AS sa GROUP BY sa.SignalRegistry, sa.SignalClass, sa.SSM, sa.EntropyVal, sa.ModType, sa.ModIndex;

failures.question: Classify signals by TOLS Category, and for each group, show the category name, signal count, average Bandwidth-to-Frequency Ratio, and the standard deviation of the anomaly score.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH metrics AS (
    SELECT
        s.SignalRegistry,
        sp.TechSigProb,
        sp.NatSrcProb,
        sp.SigUnique,
        sp.AnomScore,
        s.BwHz,
        s.CenterFreqMhz,
        (sp.TechSigProb * (1 - sp.NatSrcProb) * sp.SigUnique * (0.5 + sp.AnomScore / 10.0)) AS TOLS,
        (s.BwHz / (s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000.0)) AS BFR
    FROM signals s
    JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.SignalRegistry = sp.SignalRef
    WHERE sp.TechSigProb IS NOT NULL
      AND sp.NatSrcProb IS NOT NULL
      AND sp.SigUnique IS NOT NULL
      AND sp.AnomScore IS NOT NULL
      AND s.BwHz IS NOT NULL
      AND s.CenterFreqMhz IS NOT NULL
      AND s.CenterFreqMhz > 0
),
categorized AS (
    SELECT
        metrics.*,
        CASE
            WHEN TOLS < 0.25 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN TOLS < 0.75 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS TOLSCategory
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    TOLSCategory AS "TOLS Category",
    COUNT(*) AS "Signal Count",
    AVG(BFR) AS "Average BFR",
    SQRT(AVG(AnomScore * AnomScore) - AVG(AnomScore) * AVG(AnomScore)) AS "StdDev AnomScore"
FROM categorized
GROUP BY TOLSCategory
ORDER BY CASE TOLSCategory
             WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
             WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
             WHEN 'High' THEN 3
         END;
failures.sol_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.TechSigProb * (1 - p.NatSrcProb) * p.SigUnique * (0.5 + p.AnomScore/10) < 0.25 THEN 'Low' WHEN p.TechSigProb * (1 - p.NatSrcProb) * p.SigUnique * (0.5 + p.AnomScore/10) < 0.75 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS tol_category, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, AVG(s.BwHz/(s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000)) AS avg_bfr, AVG(p.AnomScore*p.AnomScore) - AVG(p.AnomScore)*AVG(p.AnomScore) AS anomaly_stddev FROM Signals s JOIN SignalProbabilities p ON s.SignalRegistry = p.SignalRef GROUP BY tol_category

failures.question: Which observatory stations are discovering the most potential technosignatures? For each station, display the observatory name, how many signals meet our technosignature criteria, their average TOLS score, average BFR values, and what percentage of all detected technosignatures they've found. I need this ranked by the stations with the most discoveries first.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH techno_signals AS (
  SELECT
    s.signalregistry,
    t.observstation,
    sp.TechSigProb * (1 - sp.NatSrcProb) * sp.SigUnique * (0.5 + sp.AnomScore / 10.0) AS TOLS,
    s.BwHz / (s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000.0) AS BFR
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
  JOIN signalclassification sc ON s.signalregistry = sc.signalref
  WHERE sp.TechSigProb > 0.7
    AND sp.NatSrcProb < 0.3
    AND sp.ArtSrcProb < 50
    AND s.BwHz / (s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000.0) < 0.001
    AND sc.infodense > 0.8
)
SELECT
  ts.observstation AS observatory_name,
  COUNT(*) AS technosignature_count,
  AVG(ts.TOLS) AS avg_TOLS,
  AVG(ts.BFR) AS avg_BFR,
  (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM techno_signals)) AS percentage_of_all_technosignatures
FROM techno_signals ts
GROUP BY ts.observstation
ORDER BY technosignature_count DESC;
failures.sol_sql: WITH tech_signals AS ( SELECT s.SignalRegistry, s.TelescRef, p.TechSigProb * ( 1 - p.NatSrcProb ) * p.SigUnique * ( 0.5 + p.AnomScore / 10 ) AS TOLS, s.BwHz / ( s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000 ) AS BFR FROM Signals AS s JOIN SignalProbabilities AS p ON s.SignalRegistry = p.SignalRef WHERE p.TechSigProb > 0.7 AND p.NatSrcProb < 0.3 AND p.ArtSrcProb < 50 AND s.BwHz / ( s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000 ) < 0.001 ) SELECT t.ObservStation, COUNT(*) AS potential_tech_signals, AVG(ts.TOLS) AS avg_tols, AVG(ts.BFR) AS avg_bfr, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tech_signals ) AS percentage_of_total FROM tech_signals AS ts JOIN Telescopes AS t ON ts.TelescRef = t.TelescRegistry GROUP BY t.ObservStation ORDER BY potential_tech_signals DESC NULLS FIRST

failures.question: Which observatories have the most promising signals worth investigating? I need a summary by observatory showing the observatory name, their total signal count, average Research Priority Index (RPI) and approximate Confirmation Confidence Score (CCS) values, number of high-priority (RPI > 3) signals, number of high-confidence signals, and especially the number of signals that meet both criteria. Sort the results by observatories with the most high-priority-and-high-confidence signals first.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH signal_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    t.observstation,
    s.signalregistry,
    (sp.TechSigProb * 4 + sp.BioSigProb / 100 + sp.SigUnique * 2 + sp.AnomScore / 2) * (1 - sp.FalsePosProb) AS rpi,
    (1 - sp.FalsePosProb) * sd.DecodeConf * sc.ClassConf *
      CASE WHEN (s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm)) > 0
           THEN (s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm)) / 10 + 0.5
           ELSE 0.1
      END AS ccs
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
  LEFT JOIN signaldecoding sd ON s.signalregistry = sd.signalref
  LEFT JOIN signalclassification sc ON s.signalregistry = sc.signalref
)
SELECT
  sm.observstation AS "Observatory Name",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total signal count",
  AVG(sm.rpi) AS "Average RPI",

  SUM(CASE WHEN sm.rpi > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "High-priority signals",
  SUM(CASE WHEN sm.ccs > 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "High-confidence signals",
  SUM(CASE WHEN sm.rpi > 3 AND sm.ccs > 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Both high-priority and high-confidence"
FROM signal_metrics sm
GROUP BY sm.observstation
ORDER BY "Both high-priority and high-confidence" DESC;

failures.question: Create a report evaluating observatory conditions using the Atmospheric Observability Index (AOI) and identifying stations meeting Optimal Observing Window (OOW) criteria. The output should group stations by whether meets OOW (bool:True or False). For each group, you should provide its boolean value of OOW, the count of stations, average AOI (rounded to 3 decimal places) and a JSON array whose elements each include  `station` (observatory name), `aoi` (AOI value), `lunar_factors` object with `stage` (lunar stage) and `distance` (lunar distance), and `solar_status` (solar status).
failures.pred_sql:
WITH station_aoi AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    AtmosTransparency,
    HumidityRate,
    WindSpeedMs,
    LunarStage,
    LunarDistDeg,
    SolarStatus,
    (AtmosTransparency * (1 - HumidityRate/100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * WindSpeedMs)) AS aoi
  FROM observatories
),
station_oow AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE 
      WHEN aoi > 0.85 
       AND LunarStage IN ('New', 'First Quarter') 
       AND LunarDistDeg > 45 
       AND SolarStatus IN ('Low', 'Moderate') 
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END AS meets_oow
  FROM station_aoi
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN meets_oow = 1 THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS OOW,
  COUNT(*) AS stations_count,
  ROUND(AVG(aoi), 3) AS avg_aoi,
  json_group_array(
    json_object(
      'station', observstation,
      'aoi', aoi,
      'lunar_factors', json_object('stage', LunarStage, 'distance', LunarDistDeg),
      'solar_status', SolarStatus
    )
  ) AS stations_json
FROM station_oow
GROUP BY meets_oow
ORDER BY meets_oow DESC;
failures.sol_sql: SELECT is_optimal_window, COUNT(*) AS station_count, ROUND(AVG(aoi), 3) AS avg_aoi, JSON_GROUP_ARRAY(JSON_OBJECT( 'station', ObservStation, 'aoi', ROUND(aoi, 3), 'lunar_factors', JSON_OBJECT( 'stage', LunarStage, 'distance', LunarDistDeg ), 'solar_status', SolarStatus )) AS observatory_details FROM ( SELECT o.ObservStation, o.AtmosTransparency * (1 - o.HumidityRate/100) * (1 - 0.02 * o.WindSpeedMs) AS aoi, o.LunarStage, o.LunarDistDeg, o.SolarStatus, CASE WHEN o.AtmosTransparency * (1 - o.HumidityRate/100) * (1 - 0.02 * o.WindSpeedMs) > 0.85 AND (o.LunarStage = 'New' OR o.LunarStage = 'First Quarter') AND o.LunarDistDeg > 45 AND (o.SolarStatus = 'Low' OR o.SolarStatus = 'Moderate') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_optimal_window FROM Observatories o ) GROUP BY is_optimal_window;

failures.question: Give me a ranked list of all our observatory sites by their current observation quality. For each observatory, I need fileds: the station name, telescope ID, calculated Observation Quality Factor, any equipment problems listed together sepearated by comma, how many issues there are, and the Observational Confidence Level. Please rank them by Observation Quality Factor with the best first.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    t.telescregistry,
    o.atmostransparency,
    o.humidityrate,
    o.windspeedms,
    o.lunardistdeg,
    t.pointaccarc,
    t.equipstatus,
    t.calibrstatus,
    t.coolsysstatus
  FROM observatories o
  JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
calc AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescregistry,
    atmostransparency * (1 - humidityrate/100) * (1 - 0.02 * windspeedms) AS AOI,
    (1 - lunardistdeg/180) * (1 - atmostransparency) AS LIF,
    pointaccarc,
    equipstatus,
    calibrstatus,
    coolsysstatus
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescregistry,
  AOI * (1 - LIF) * (CASE WHEN pointaccarc < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2/pointaccarc END) AS OQF,
  (SELECT group_concat(issue, ', ') FROM (
    SELECT 'equipstatus: ' || equipstatus AS issue WHERE equipstatus != 'Operational'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'calibrstatus: ' || calibrstatus WHERE calibrstatus != 'Current'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'coolsysstatus: ' || coolsysstatus WHERE coolsysstatus != 'Normal'
  )) AS equipment_problems,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT 1 WHERE equipstatus != 'Operational'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1 WHERE calibrstatus != 'Current'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1 WHERE coolsysstatus != 'Normal'
  )) AS issue_count,
  CASE
    WHEN AOI > 0.8 AND equipstatus = 'Operational' AND calibrstatus = 'Current' AND coolsysstatus = 'Normal'
      THEN 'High'
    WHEN AOI BETWEEN 0.5 AND 0.8 AND equipstatus = 'Operational' AND calibrstatus = 'Current' AND coolsysstatus = 'Normal'
      THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS OCL,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AOI * (1 - LIF) * (CASE WHEN pointaccarc < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2/pointaccarc END) DESC) AS rank
FROM calc

    FROM scanprocessing sp

WITH spatial_area AS (

    FROM scanspatial
    GROUP BY arcref, crewref
),
cloud_site AS (
    SELECT p.cloudregistry, p.TotalPts, p.CloudDense,
           MIN(sc.zoneref) AS zoneref,
           sa.avg_area
    FROM scanpointcloud p
    JOIN scans sc ON p.arcref = sc.arcref AND p.crewref = sc.crewref
    LEFT JOIN spatial_area sa ON p.arcref = sa.arcref AND p.crewref = sa.crewref
    GROUP BY p.cloudregistry, p.TotalPts, p.CloudDense
),

    SELECT zoneref,
           CASE WHEN avg_area IS NOT NULL AND avg_area > 0 AND CloudDense > 0
                THEN 1.0 * TotalPts / (CloudDense * avg_area)
           END AS pcdr,
           CloudDense
    FROM cloud_site
),
site_aggregates AS (
    SELECT zoneref,
           AVG(pcdr) AS avg_pcdr,

    FROM cloud_pcdr

       CASE

                AND sa.avg_cloud_dense IS NOT NULL
                AND (fs.total_traits + fs.total_arti) IS NOT NULL
                AND sa.avg_cloud_dense > 0
                AND sa.avg_pcdr > 0
           THEN ( (fs.total_traits + fs.total_arti) * 1000.0 ) / (sa.avg_pcdr * SQRT(sa.avg_cloud_dense))

        CASE WHEN sai IS NOT NULL AND dtr IS NOT NULL AND tle IS NOT NULL AND omi IS NOT NULL

failures.pred_sql:
SELECT 
    ri.churnflag AS churn_risk_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.userregistry) AS fan_count,
    ROUND(AVG(julianday('now') - julianday(ps.lastlogdt)), 2) AS avg_days_since_lastlogin,
    ROUND(AVG(e.engrate), 2) AS avg_engagement_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(ps.intconsist), 2) AS avg_interaction_consistency,
    ROUND(AVG(
        (1 - ps.intconsist) * 2 
        + ((julianday('now') - julianday(ps.lastlogdt)) / 30) * 0.5 
        + (CASE ri.churnflag 
            WHEN 'None' THEN 0 
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'High' THEN 3 
            ELSE 0 END) / 3.0 * 2
    ), 2) AS avg_retention_risk_factor
FROM retentionandinfluence ri
JOIN engagement e ON ri.retainengagepivot = e.engagereg
JOIN membershipandspending m ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
JOIN fans f ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
JOIN preferencesandsettings ps ON m.memberreg = ps.preferencesmemberpivot
GROUP BY ri.churnflag
ORDER BY ri.churnflag;
failures.sol_sql: SELECT r.churnflag, COUNT(*) AS fan_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CURRENT_DATE - p.lastlogdt) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_days_since_login, ROUND(CAST(AVG(e.engrate) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_engagement_rate, ROUND(CAST(AVG(p.intconsist) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_interaction_consistency, ROUND( CAST(AVG( ( 1 - p.intconsist ) * 2 + ( CURRENT_DATE - p.lastlogdt ) / 30.0 * 0.5 + CASE WHEN r.churnflag = 'None' THEN 0 WHEN r.churnflag = 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN r.churnflag = 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN r.churnflag = 'High' THEN 3 END ) AS REAL), 2 ) AS avg_retention_risk_factor FROM fans AS f JOIN membershipandspending AS ms ON ms.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry JOIN engagement AS e ON e.engagememberpivot = ms.memberreg JOIN retentionandinfluence AS r ON r.retainengagepivot = e.engagereg JOIN preferencesandsettings AS p ON p.preferencesmemberpivot = ms.memberreg GROUP BY r.churnflag

failures.question: Provide me with each fan's id, nickname, their calculated FLV value (rounded to 2 decimals), and classify them based on Fan Value Segmentation. Please sort the results by FLV in descending order.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH fan_gift AS (
    SELECT
        i.interactfanpivot AS userregistry,
        SUM(i.gifttot) AS total_gifttot
    FROM interactions i
    GROUP BY i.interactfanpivot
),
fan_membership AS (
    SELECT
        m.memberfanpivot AS userregistry,
        MAX(m.spendusd) AS spendusd,
        MAX(m.membdays) AS membdays,
        MAX(m.memberreg) AS memberreg
    FROM membershipandspending m
    GROUP BY m.memberfanpivot
),
fan_engage AS (
    SELECT
        e.engagememberpivot AS memberreg,
        MAX(e.engrate) AS engrate,
        MAX(e.socintscore) AS socintscore,
        MAX(e.actdayswk) AS actdayswk,
        MAX(e.avgsesscount) AS avgsesscount,
        MAX(e.engagereg) AS engagereg
    FROM engagement e
    GROUP BY e.engagememberpivot
),
fan_pref AS (
    SELECT
        p.preferencesmemberpivot AS memberreg,
        MAX(p.intconsist) AS intconsist,
        MAX(p.lastlogdt) AS lastlogdt
    FROM preferencesandsettings p
    GROUP BY p.preferencesmemberpivot
),
fan_retention AS (
    SELECT
        r.retainengagepivot AS engagereg,
        MAX(r.churnflag) AS churnflag
    FROM retentionandinfluence r
    GROUP BY r.retainengagepivot
),
fan_metrics_base AS (
    SELECT
        f.userregistry,
        f.nicklabel,
        COALESCE(fm.spendusd, 0) AS spendusd,
        COALESCE(fm.membdays, 0) AS membdays,
        COALESCE(fg.total_gifttot, 0) AS total_gifttot,
        COALESCE(fe.engrate, 0) AS engrate,
        COALESCE(fe.socintscore, 0) AS socintscore,
        COALESCE(fe.actdayswk, 0) AS actdayswk,
        COALESCE(fe.avgsesscount, 0) AS avgsesscount,
        COALESCE(fp.intconsist, 0) AS intconsist,
        fp.lastlogdt,
        fr.churnflag
    FROM fans f
    LEFT JOIN fan_membership fm ON f.userregistry = fm.userregistry
    LEFT JOIN fan_engage fe ON fm.memberreg = fe.memberreg
    LEFT JOIN fan_pref fp ON fm.memberreg = fp.memberreg
    LEFT JOIN fan_retention fr ON fe.engagereg = fr.engagereg
    LEFT JOIN fan_gift fg ON f.userregistry = fg.userregistry
),
fan_calc AS (
    SELECT
        userregistry,
        nicklabel,
        (spendusd * (1 + membdays / 365.0 * 0.5) * (1 + total_gifttot / 10.0 * 0.2)) AS MV,
        (engrate * 0.4 + socintscore / 100.0 * 0.3 + actdayswk / 7.0 * 0.2 + avgsesscount / 10.0 * 0.1) AS FEI,
        ((1 - intconsist) * 2 +
         CASE
            WHEN lastlogdt IS NOT NULL THEN (julianday('now') - julianday(lastlogdt)) / 30.0
            ELSE 0
         END * 0.5 +
         (CASE churnflag
            WHEN 'None' THEN 0
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN 'High' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
         END) / 3.0 * 2) AS RRF
    FROM fan_metrics_base
),
fan_flv AS (
    SELECT
        userregistry,
        nicklabel,
        ROUND(MV * (1 - RRF / 10.0) * (1 + FEI) * 24, 2) AS flv_value
    FROM fan_calc
),
percentiles AS (
    SELECT
        flv_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY flv_value ASC) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
    FROM fan_flv
),
p_values AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CAST(CEIL(total_count * 0.5) AS INTEGER) THEN flv_value END) AS p50,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CAST(CEIL(total_count * 0.75) AS INTEGER) THEN flv_value END) AS p75,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CAST(CEIL(total_count * 0.9) AS INTEGER) THEN flv_value END) AS p90
    FROM percentiles
)
SELECT
    f.userregistry,
    f.nicklabel,
    f.flv_value,
    CASE
        WHEN f.flv_value >= pv.p90 THEN 'Top Tier'
        WHEN f.flv_value >= pv.p75 THEN 'High Value'
        WHEN f.flv_value >= pv.p50 THEN 'Medium Value'
        ELSE 'Low Value'
    END AS fan_value_segmentation
FROM fan_flv f
CROSS JOIN p_values pv
ORDER BY f.flv_value DESC;

failures.question: I need to identify our Community Pillars for upcoming platform development discussions. Show me a list of our community leaders with their nicknames, calculated Community Contribution Index scores rounded to two decimal places, their group roles, activity frequency, and membership duration in days. Only include fans who meet all the Community Pillar criteria. Sort the results by CCI score in descending order.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH fan_raw AS (
    SELECT
        f.nicklabel,
        m.membdays,
        e.actfreq,
        e.engrate,
        e.socintscore,
        e.actdayswk,
        e.avgsesscount,
        s.collabcount,
        json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.group_involvement.grprole') AS grprole,
        CAST(json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.contqualrate') AS REAL) AS contqualrate,
        CAST(json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.ugcval') AS REAL) AS ugcval,
        CAST(json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.network.follcount') AS REAL) AS follcount,
        r.viralcont
    FROM fans f
    JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
    JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
    JOIN socialcommunity s ON s.socialengagepivot = e.engagereg
    JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retainengagepivot = e.engagereg
    WHERE e.actfreq = 'Daily'
      AND m.membdays > 180
      AND json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.group_involvement.grprole') IN ('Moderator', 'Leader')
)
SELECT
    nicklabel,
    ROUND(
        (contqualrate * (ugcval / 10.0) * (1 + (follcount / 100.0) * 0.5)) * 0.4
        + ((follcount / 100.0) * (engrate * 2.0) * (viralcont + 1) * 0.5) * 0.3
        + collabcount * 0.1
        + (engrate * 0.4 + (socintscore / 100.0) * 0.3 + (actdayswk / 7.0) * 0.2 + (avgsesscount / 10.0) * 0.1) * 0.2,
        2
    ) AS CCI,
    grprole,
    actfreq,
    membdays
FROM fan_raw
WHERE CCI > 7
ORDER BY CCI DESC;

failures.question: Show me a list of fans with their user ID, nicknames, how many different idols they support, the names of these idols in array, and their average engagement rate rounded to 2 decimal places. Only include fans who are classified as Multi-Idol Supporters. Sort the results first by the number of idols supported (highest first), then by engagement rate (highest first).
failures.pred_sql:
SELECT f.userregistry AS user_id,
       f.nicklabel,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) AS idol_count,
       json_group_array(DISTINCT v.nametag) AS idol_names,
       ROUND(AVG(e.engrate), 2) AS avg_engagement_rate
FROM fans f
JOIN interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
JOIN virtualidols v ON i.interactidolpivot = v.entityreg
JOIN engagement e ON i.activityreg = e.engageactivitypivot
GROUP BY f.userregistry, f.nicklabel
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) >= 2
   AND AVG(e.engrate) > 0.4
ORDER BY idol_count DESC, avg_engagement_rate DESC;
failures.sol_sql: SELECT f.userregistry, f.nicklabel, COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) AS idols_supported, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT vi.nametag) AS idol_names, ROUND(AVG(e.engrate), 2) AS avg_engagement_rate FROM fans f JOIN interactions i ON i.interactfanpivot = f.userregistry JOIN virtualidols vi ON vi.entityreg = i.interactidolpivot JOIN membershipandspending ms ON ms.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = ms.memberreg WHERE e.engrate > 0.4 GROUP BY f.userregistry, f.nicklabel HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) >= 2 ORDER BY idols_supported DESC, avg_engagement_rate DESC;
